compared: DSH-alg-jep135-hom-local claims Thm-hom-local, a theorem about the homological support of a big tensor-triangulated category; this lemma is a structural statement about the Serre tensor ideal induced by a homological functor and the localisation diagram it produces, and it is proved independently of that theorem.
DSH-alg-jep135-spc-image claims Thm-Spc-image, a different author result of the same paper; neither statement implies the other.
The labels of this lemma and of its clauses are free in the corpus after normalisation.
